assets.label: hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel
assets.service: diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression

control_failures.control_label: receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at V-4110

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EXPLOSIVES_RECONCILIATION: the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives on V-4110 and LT-4110 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in storing and transporting explosives, specifically receiving, magazining and reconciling explosives. V-4110 (hydrocarbon day tanks and surge vessel) is in service for diesel and light hydrocarbon day storage, discharge surge suppression. The task proceeded during shift handover while the receipt, magazining and reconciliation of explosives was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 10 April 2006 a near hit was recorded on V-4110 and LT-4110 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during shift handover; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
